subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `ChannelMessageActionAdapter.normalizeMessageActionRequest` as a supported Plugin SDK hook for owner-side action translation and repair?
rationale: This change adds a cross-channel public adapter phase whose behavior affects third-party plugin compatibility and the ordering of authorization, validation, hydration, and durable delivery; generated API baselines do not establish product ownership of that contract.

options.title: Adopt and document the SDK hook
options.body: Approve the hook as stable, define its ordering and failure semantics, and retain focused contract coverage for external channel adapters.

options.title: Narrow the implementation seam
options.body: Replace the public hook with an approved narrower core or bundled-plugin boundary if external plugins do not need this capability.

options.title: Pause for channel SDK direction
options.body: Hold this PR until the channel/plugin API owner selects the permanent compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt and document the SDK hook
recommendation.body: Approve the hook as stable, define its ordering and failure semantics, and retain focused contract coverage for external channel adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied review context does not identify the current-main owner of the public channel adapter contract.
